subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配体分类：下列配体属于哪一种 L/X 类型：hydride, bridging (μ-H)（μ-H）？
A. X
B. L₂X
C. L₂X₂
D. LX₂
explanation: μ-H (hydride, bridging (μ-H)) is an X ligand: each L gives 2 electrons and each X one, so 1 electrons in the covalent count (2 in the ionic count).
